query:
SELECT 
  DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') as month,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  MIN(createdAt) as earliest,
  MAX(createdAt) as latest
FROM conversations
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month DESC;
